I wouldn’t go again!
Aug 2026 • Couples
★★☆☆☆

Unfortunately, this was a disappointing experience from start to finish.

The first coffee I was served had a long black hair hanging from it, so I had to send it back. The replacement was supposed to be made with condensed milk, but instead it contained a salted cream. At first I thought the cream had gone bad, so I asked the waiter. He explained that it was intentionally a salt-based coffee drink. That may be a local specialty, but it wasn’t described that way, and I couldn’t drink it.

The breakfast was also underwhelming. The eggs and croissant were barely edible. The strawberry cream croissant was the best item we tried, but even that was only average—the amount of filling completely overwhelmed the pastry.

Between the hygiene issue, the unexpected coffee, and the mediocre breakfast, this wasn’t an experience I’d return for.

Incredible, tasty, one of a kind
Jul 2023 • Family
We went for brunch a morning, while on vacation in Ho Chi Minh City, because we couldn’t stand the hotel breakfast. And let me tell you, it was the best brunch we’ve ever had. To start off, the interior was incredibly clean and modern with fun artsy details everywhere. We were immediately brought to a table by the sweetest waiter who spoke incredibly good English. We were brought menus which included both sweet and savory brunch dishes, as well as some American classics such as French toast and eggs Benedict, but also a great selection of Vietnamese spins on brunch. We tried a bit of everything savory and it was all really good and tasty. Especially the salmon/avocado eggs Benedict stood out. We also tried a selection of specialty smoothies, juices and coffees which were all REALLY good. Like seriously good, definitely recommend the tiramisu latte. But the star of the entire brunch was the baked goods/dessert. We had both the s’mores croissant (which was literally the size of my face), the crème brûlée French toast and the pancakes, and it was all amazing. The had really unique flavor combinations for their baked goods, and they were definitely one of a kind. Another honorable mention was the plating of all the dishes which were so accurate and with such attention to detail, like literally art. It was all absolutely beautiful. Lastly there’s just to mention that the food came really quick and was freshly made, which just made the whole experience even more special. If you have a free morning in Ho Chi Minh City, I would absolutely urge you to go there, as the food is awesome and the service is so great.
